iron_spider.notes: Staged, not bundled. Download the model from Sketchfab while signed in, then run: node scripts/install-character-model.mjs <downloaded .glb> --identity "Iron Spider" --facing 0 --attribution "<credit>" --license "<licence>" --source <model url>. The installer copies it here, enables this entry and prints the credit line to paste into public/ATTRIBUTIONS.md.
